text:
ravi: Heads up — in the last 10m eu-west egress is spiking 502/504s for Dedicated GPU jobs. I see SNAT port exhaustion on nat-gateway-1 and a bunch of conntrack evictions. Provisioning for new pods is failing sometimes.
ops-ci-bot: [ALERT] 1975123456 - NAT_PORT_EXHAUSTION detected on nat-gateway-1 (eu-west-1). Count: 1243 events / 10m.
gwen: yep saw it on the dashboard, LB returns TCP reset frequently. Any recent geo-DNS or weighting pushes?
diego: not from infra, but platform rolled a small region-weight tweak 12m ago to divert 5% traffic -> eu-west for load balancing tests.
emily: that tweak could cause connection reshuffle across SNAT pools and blow up ephemeral ports if clients open many concurrent connections.
ravi: logs show a lot of short-lived TLS handshakes from the orchestration agents (provisioning checks). They create many outbound sockets quickly. conntrack table size hit 65536 and started evicting.
gwen: can we quick patch host sysctl to increase nf_conntrack_max and ephemeral port range? command I run locally:
```
# on host
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"
```
diego: temporary tune is fine, but we should also reduce connection churn. Maybe enable keepalive for provisioning or reuse HTTP/2 multiplexing from the agent.
emily: also suggest increasing egress-grace window on geo routing. The current region-fallback grace = 15s, that causes repeated reflows when health probes jitter. bump to 60s for a controlled handover.
ravi: agreed. quick plan: 1) rollback the 5% geo-weight test (diego), 2) increase conntrack + port range on affected nat hosts (gwen), 3) enable short-term pump-down of provisioning parallelism (emily) to avoid spikes, 4) schedule longer-term: connection pooling in agents + sticky egress by pod.
diego: rolling back geo-weight now. patch id: rl/1975-geo-weight-revert.
gwen: applying sysctl on nat-box fleet (eu-west). Doing in small batches to avoid host-level reboot.
emily: I'll flip provisioning parallelism from 50 -> 10 for 30m via runtime feature flag.
ops-ci-bot: Action created: INC-1975123456 - nat-conntrack-tuning (assigned to gwen).
ravi: after the changes we should monitor SNAT port usage and conntrack occupancy for 30m. Also capture tcpdump on a replica to confirm TLS sessions reused.
diego: noted. If conntrack still saturates, fallback is to enable NAT gateway autoscaling or move to instances with multiple ENIs to get more ports.
gwen: quick check: `ss -tan state time-wait` shows many TIME_WAIT from provisioning clients. So TCP close behavior is amplifying port reuse. Might be worthwhile to lower TIME_WAIT on the agent side (SO_LINGER?) but that's risky.
emily: for immediate mitigation, I've deployed keepalive=true for agent HTTP client in the flag group `provisioner/egress-reuse`.
ravi: thanks. we'll reconvene in 20m. please paste dashboard links and any failing job ids in this thread if you see reoccurrence. :thumbsup:
